A.)', P8_4 'Hablar el idioma o con el acento del lugar', P8_5 'Ser descendiente de varias generaciones de personas nacidas en ella'; VALUE LABELS for all five 1 'Mucha' 2 'Bastante' 3 'Poca' 7 'Ninguna' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.'. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do imports 3409_num.csv, runs 'rename *, lower' and loops gen item = the literal names p8_1..p8_5, so the item code IS the CIS column name lowercased; nothing positional, Step 5b exempt, no verification_/verify_ files written. CHECKED ANYWAY, decisively: re-running the .do logic on 3409_num.csv (id = row number; 8/9 to missing; 7 recoded to 4) reproduces the live table exactly -- 37889 rows, id-item-resp row sets identical (0/0 set differences) against the local irw cache copy made by table_context.R (no additional export); item x resp counts at 1/2/3/4: p8_1 1865/2393/1959/1367, p8_2 1698/2207/2276/1379, p8_3 2755/3276/1079/480, p8_4 1695/2275/2323/1278, p8_5 1340/1659/2517/2068; per-item n 7584/7560/7590/7571/7584 matches irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE) (p8_1 and p8_5 tie on n, so n alone would not separate them; the cell-level match does). Route 8 coherence: p8_3 (lived there most of one's life) is rated most important (6031 of 7590 at Mucha/Bastante) and p8_5 (descent from several generations) least (2068 at Ninguna). text_source=study_materials: Spanish transcribed from cues3409.pdf (pdftotext -layout and raw). p8_3 ships the questionnaire's fuller 'Haber vivido en ... la mayor parte de su vida'; the variable label truncates it at the placeholder. The other four agree with the labels character for character. PIPED TEXT: the questionnaire prints CATI fill tokens '@1@2...@20' where the respondent's own autonomous community was inserted (P8_1, P8_3, and twice in the carrier question). Per SKILL Step 4 these are replaced with CIS's own published placeholder '(gentilicio de la C. A.)', taken from the P8_1/P8_3 variable labels; the English twin reads '(demonym of the autonomous community)'. No respondent's actual region is shown. instructions = the P.8 carrier question verbatim (both sentences) with the placeholder substituted; the trailing interviewer direction '(ENTREVISTADOR/A: REPETIR LA PREGUNTA Y LA ESCALA DE RESPUESTA PARA CADA ÍTEM)' is not addressed to the respondent and is not shipped. section_prompt blank, one trivial section_id: P.8 is a single flat grid. RESP: CIS codes the lowest category 'Ninguna' as 7, not 4; the .do's 'replace resp = 4 if resp == 7' stores it as resp 4, so option_text 'Ninguna' sits at resp 4. 8 N.S. and 9 N.C. (p8_1 42/17, p8_2 55/28, p8_3 29/24, p8_4 27/45, p8_5 31/28 of 7643) are dropped to missing and have no option row. resp 1 = most importance (Mucha) ... 4 = none. All four levels are used on every item and every item carries four option rows. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3409 in Spanish only; the four _translated columns were written by IRW. STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Importance of birthplace, nationality, residence, language, and ancestry for being considered truly of the autonomous community' matches P8_1..P8_5 exactly; no instrument mismatch. SIBLINGS: md3409 also covers spain_2023_identity_{centralism,europe,identification,patriotism,pride,state,territorial}; none of their files were touched. RIGHTS: no block; applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, scope every CIS study any year, widened 2026-09-23 irw#2381). Reuse page re-fetched 2026-09-24 (HTTP 200, sha256 e4f330fb44e00c3312964f20f98dbc409cf90305342faef5ad2b2b5244e0b02d; not a stable hash by design) and operative text re-read: 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilización de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales' and 'la cesión gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual'. Processing script data/spain_2023_identity.do (Bookmark 7: centralism). Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels. The CIS microdata deposit MD3409.zip (md5 862690b9f7eee397310dae6f40b3264a) ships 3409.sav, whose VARIABLE labels tie each source column to a party -- ESCALACENTRALISMO_1 'PSOE', _2 'PP', _3 'VOX', _4 'Ciudadanos', _5 'Podemos', _6 'Sumar' -- and whose VALUE labels (identical on all six) are 1 'Máximo centralismo', 2..9 labelled only with their own digit, 10 'Máxima descentralización', 98 'N.S.', 99 'N.C.'. The same six parties appear in the same order as the rows of the P15 [ESCALACENTRALISMO] grid in the questionnaire, and codigo3409.pdf lists P15 as ESCALACENTRALISMO_1..6 '* PSOE * PP * VOX * Ciudadanos * Podemos * Sumar'. DERIVATION (core model s3 pattern 1): data/spain_2023_identity.do imports 3409_num.csv, runs 'rename *, lower', and in Bookmark 7 loops gen item = "`var'" over the literal list escalacentralismo_1..escalacentralismo_6 -- the IRW item code IS the source column name lowercased, nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt and no verification/verify_*.R was written. CHECKED ANYWAY, with no Redivis export: applying the do-file's filter (98, 99 to missing) to 3409_num.csv (N=7643) gives per-column n 7190 / 7167 / 7039 / 6976 / 7049 / 5954 for ESCALACENTRALISMO_1..6, and irw::irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE) returns exactly 7190 / 7167 / 7039 / 6976 / 7049 / 5954 for escalacentralismo_1..6 (41,375 live rows). All six counts are distinct, so no permutation of the party labels is consistent with the data. Semantic sanity: VOX (item 3) has its mode at 1 'Máximo centralismo' (3945 of 7039), while Podemos and Sumar have modes at 10, as expected. text_source=study_materials: instructions is the P15 question verbatim from CIS's questionnaire cues3409pdf.pdf as served on the study page (https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1557711/cues3409pdf.pdf, sha256 0674bf7011dddb43b95438bbeae1b89c6a88ffcd06da39124a074f158bc37575), line break joined with a space, no trailing period (the source has none). The copy of the questionnaire inside MD3409.zip (cues3409.pdf) has the identical wording but carries a stray HTML artifact '</strong' after the closing quote; the study-page copy was used and the artifact not shipped. item_text is the party name as printed in the grid row and in the .sav variable label. option_text is shipped for resp 1 and 10 only (the grid's end-point labels); resp 2..9 carry no verbal label in the questionnaire (the .sav value labels are just the digits), so option_text is left blank for them rather than padded. 98 N.S. and 99 N.C. are set to missing by the do-file and absent from the live resp set {1..10}; every item uses all ten levels. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes no English version of Estudio 3409; the English in the _translated columns was produced by IRW. Party names are proper nouns and are carried unchanged into item_text_translated. section_prompt blank, single trivial section_id. STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Placement of national political parties on a centralism versus decentralization scale' matches P15 exactly; no instrument mismatch. cues3409.pdf covers eight IRW tables (identification P5, territorial P7, authenticity P8, patriotism P9, pride P11/P12, state P13/P14, centralism P15, europe P16/P17); only P15 was extracted here. RIGHTS: no block. CIS is the rights holder of its own questionnaire, and its reuse conditions (https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis, fetched 2026-09-24, sha256 of page a09dd24db6d15758e4d8a3807b46c15d4bbc4df4f19ca13b34d7251aad63361c) grant a positive right: 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilización de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales' and 'La reutilización autorizada incluye, a modo ilustrativo, actividades como la copia, difusión, modificación, adaptación, extracción, reordenación y combinación de la información'. Same verdict as the shipped spain_2025_* CIS siblings. No instrument_rights_register.csv row written (a round may not write a ship row).

Only the scale end points (1 and 10) carry verbal labels; values 2-9 were unlabelled in the questionnaire.

note: mapping_basis=data_labels: md3409.zip ships 3409.sav, whose variable labels tie each column to its question -- P16 'Posicionamiento ante la pertenencia de Espana a la Union Europea', P17 'Posicionamiento ante la pertenencia a su comunidad autonoma de residencia a la Union Europea' -- and whose value labels give 1 'Mas bien le ha beneficiado', 2 '(NO LEER) Ni le ha beneficiado ni le ha perjudicado', 3 'Mas bien le ha perjudicado', 8 N.S., 9 N.C. for both. Derivation is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2023_identity.do imports 3409_num.csv, does 'rename *, lower' and sets item = the column name, so p16/p17 ARE the source columns; Step 5b exempt. Checked against the data anyway: the .sav frequencies are P16 1=6300 / 2=254 / 3=944 / 8=118 / 9=27 and P17 1=5999 / 2=238 / 3=1148 / 8=225 / 9=33; dropping {2,8,9} as the .do file does leaves n=7244 (p16) and 7147 (p17), matching the live per-item n from irw_table_sets exactly (no export). text_source=study_materials: item_text and option_text transcribed verbatim from cues3409.pdf (P.16, P.17 and their read-out options, checked in pdftotext -raw and -layout); option strings are character-identical to the .sav value labels. P.17 opens with 'Y' and has no explicit subject for 'beneficiado/perjudicado' because it follows P.16 in the questionnaire; kept as administered. No shared carrier text, so instructions is blank. translation_source=machine_translation: English in the _translated columns written by IRW; CIS publishes this questionnaire only in Spanish. RESP: live set 1,3. Code 2, the not-read-aloud volunteered midpoint '(NO LEER) Ni le ha beneficiado ni le ha perjudicado' (P16 254 = 3.3%, P17 238 = 3.1% of 7643), is dropped by the .do file with 8/9, so no option row is shipped for it and resp has a gap at 2 (values kept as CIS codes, not recoded to 1/2). Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Perceived benefit or harm of EU membership for Spain and for the autonomous community' matches P16+P17; no mismatch. RIGHTS: no block; applied the instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict=allow, scope every CIS study). Re-read the reuse page 2026-09-24 (sha256 b01e7313..., page has no stable hash by design); operative clause unchanged: 'permiten la reutilizacion de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales'. Siblings: md3409/cues3409.pdf also cover spain_2023_identity_{identification,territorial,authenticity,patriotism,pride,state,centralism}; only P16/P17 were extracted here.
public_note: The English item and response-option wording for this table was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes this questionnaire only in Spanish; the administered Spanish is in the base fields.
